items.title: Chow's lemma for algebraic spaces: a blowup of a separated finite type space embeds into projective space over the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S with Y separated and Noetherian, there is a U-admissible blowup X' -> X for some dense open U in X and an immersion X' -> P^n_Y. The retained proof is a full multi-paragraph argument: it first reduces via absolute Noetherian approximation to the case where Y is of finite type over Spec(Z), writing Y as a directed limit of separated finite type spaces and descending X and the generic-point configuration to a finite stage; it then builds a commutative diagram over a Noetherian base with a projective ambient space, closes out by equipping an auxiliary closed subspace Z with the very ample sheaf O_{P^n}(1), concluding Z' -> Z is H-projective, hence Z' -> Spec(Z) is H-projective and admits a closed immersion into P^m over Z, and finally verifies the diagonal X' -> P^m_Y is an immersion. Retained author proof at lines 9292-9365.
